question: The host and winner state for the Khelo India Youth Games 2020 edition is ______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Assam and Maharashtra, respectively.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Khelo India Youth Games 2020 edition was jointly hosted by Assam and Maharashtra.**
 
• The** fourth edition **of the Khelo India Youth Games was actually **hosted by the state of Haryana, India.**
 
• The event was held from January 10 to January 20, 2020, and took place across various venues in the cities of Panchkula, Ambala, and Chandigarh.
 
• Over 6,800 athletes from 37 states and union territories participated in 20 different sports disciplines in the games.
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games is an annual national-level multi-sport event organized by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India, to identify young talent and promote a sports culture in the country.
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games is an initiative of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports to promote sports at the grassroots level and identify talent for the Olympics.
 
• **The games feature 16 disciplines, including athletics, boxing, football, and swimming.**
 
• Maharashtra was one of the host states for the Khelo India Youth Games 2020 edition but not the winning state. The state hosted the first edition of the games in 2018.
 
• Assam was the winning state, and Maharashtra was one of the host states.
 
• Assam was the winning state for the Khelo India Youth Games 2020 edition, but it was not the only host state. Maharashtra was the other host state.
